task_completion.description: Open the Weasis Preferences/Settings dialog to access display configurations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A preferences or settings window is visible over the main Weasis interface.

task_completion.description: Set the image interpolation method to 'Nearest Neighbor'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The interpolation dropdown or radio button in the settings shows 'Nearest Neighbor' selected.

task_completion.description: Set the default zoom mode to 'Best Fit'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The zoom mode selection in the settings shows 'Best Fit' selected.

task_completion.description: Set the overlay font size to at least 16pt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A font size input field or slider in the preferences shows a value of 16 or higher.

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot of the viewer to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the 'Export' or 'Save' menu to save a PNG, or a file manager shows 'prefs_verification.png' in /home/ga/DICOM/exports/.

task_completion.description: Create a text file with the specific configuration lines and the chosen font size.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a file named 'prefs_changes.txt' containing: interpolation=nearest, zoom=bestfit, and font_size=16 (or higher).

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to change preferences rather than just editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Weasis Preferences menu and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The saved screenshot is a capture of the Weasis viewer with the CT scan, not a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file 'prefs_verification.png' (if previewed) or the active window shows a CT scan image with visible overlays.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or generated the text file based on the settings applied.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening a text editor or using 'echo' to create the file with the specific required content.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific persistent settings in Weasis: Interpolation must be 'Nearest Neighbor', Zoom must be 'Best Fit', and Font Size must be >= 16. The output files must be exactly /home/ga/DICOM/exports/prefs_verification.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/prefs_changes.txt. The text file must contain the three specific lines: interpolation=nearest, zoom=bestfit, and font_size=[value used].
